scheme_name: Incentives for Meritorious Children (Students) of Workers (10th and 12th Class) (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in building or construction work.
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must have at least one year of regular active membership with the Board.
Applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) or obtain one through the PPP portal.
Applicant must pay the registration fee and add a minimum of 90 days of work experience in the preceding year.
Scholarship can be availed for up to three children who have achieved academic excellence (minimum 60% marks) in Class X/XII examinations, with higher amounts for higher marks.
benefits_summary: Fixed‑deposit scholarship awarded to meritorious children of construction workers, ranging from ₹21,000 to ₹51,000 based on exam marks.
